description: HTTP contract of Workshop sessions, artifacts, approval and edits under /api (Learning context path). Authority: docs/architecture/ai-generation-platform.md sections 3-5 and 7. Implemented so far: AI-04 (#287: sessions, events, artifact) and AI-05 (#288: approval, rejection, hand-off, retry, delete, note archival). AI-13 (#291) adds EXERCISES sessions and the exercise side of approval, re-pin and retry; AI-11 (#293) and AI-06 (#289) implement or consume the rest.

conventions.owner: The JWT subject is the only owner input. Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact IDs share one opaque 404.
conventions.caching: Every response is Cache-Control: private, no-store.
conventions.ids: Canonical lowercase UUID strings. commandId is UUIDv4 or UUIDv7; entity IDs are any registered version.
conventions.versions: rowVersion, deckVersion and event cursors are decimal strings. ETag is the quoted rowVersion; If-Match is exactly one quoted canonical decimal (no weak validator, wildcard, list or leading zeros).
conventions.preconditions: Missing required precondition 428 PRECONDITION_REQUIRED, malformed 400 INVALID_REQUEST, stale 412 VERSION_CONFLICT. Approval pins the Deck version in If-Match and the artifact version, revision and Deck revision in the body. Cancel and delete need no If-Match: they are state-idempotent. A session's rowVersion bumps on every row change and is exposed as ETag for reads; no session command uses it as a precondition.
conventions.evaluationOrder: 1 authentication and ownership (foreign or unknown IDs, including an unknown or foreign note ID in sources, are 404: no existence oracle); 2 command receipt replay (same commandId and body returns the stored response with Idempotency-Replayed: true, before anything else is re-evaluated); 3 request validation (400); 4 preconditions (428, then 412 on If-Match and expected versions); 5 state (409 GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT, EDIT_IN_PROGRESS, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE, 422 limits); 6 usage (409 USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED, last, inside the admission transaction). Nothing changes state before step 6 passes.
conventions.problemExtensions: Problem extension members (capability, reason, bucket, limits ...) are added by the run-2 tasks through a small typed ProblemExtension map in platform.api; AI-01 (#281) is the first user. ApiErrorCode itself keeps its fixed status, title and detail.
conventions.idempotency: Every POST command carries commandId. An exact retry returns the stored original status and body with Idempotency-Replayed: true and no ETag; changed reuse is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Replays are not current reads: reconcile with GET.
conventions.errors: RFC 9457 application/problem+json with type urn:mnema:problem:<kebab-code>, title, status, detail, instance, code and the extension members listed in errors.json. Detail never echoes content.
conventions.bodyLimit: Request bodies are strict JSON (exact field sets, duplicate keys rejected) of at most 64 KiB; none of them carries a document.

endpoints.summary: Archive the notes the session used: exactly the NOTE sources of its PUBLISHED or HANDED_OFF artifacts, each by its pinned row_version. Explicit and idempotent.

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version.
Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.
commandId was used for a different command.

notes: No If-Match. Allowed in every session state (CLOSED, CANCELLED and EXPIRED included) until the retention worker purges the session, then 404.

"Used" means at least one PUBLISHED or HANDED_OFF artifact pins the note AND no artifact of the session still in play (QUEUED, GENERATING, PROPOSED, REVISING, STALE or a retryable FAILED) pins it: archiving bumps the note's row_version, which would turn such a sibling STALE. Notes still in use are simply not part of the command (no skip reason). Each used note is archived through the capture archive command with the pinned noteRowVersion as the expected version. A note whose current row_version differs is skipped CHANGED (never archived silently); an archived note is skipped ALREADY_ARCHIVED (checked first); a deleted one DELETED. No used notes is a 200 with empty lists.
Exact retry returns the stored response with Idempotency-Replayed: true and no ETag. A second call with a new commandId is harmless: everything archived is ALREADY_ARCHIVED.
The session is not changed: no event, no version bump. The count the UI needs is sessionDetail.notes.

endpoints.summary: Current revision (or an exact one), media slots, revision list and turns. NOTE entries of sourceRefs carry a read-time, informational status (decision 13): CURRENT (the note is at the pinned row_version), CHANGED (its row_version moved and it is not only archived), ARCHIVED (it moved, is archived and its text is still the pinned text) or DELETED. It never changes the artifact: staleness stays decision 4.

query.revisionId: optional: read this revision's payload; the current pointer is unchanged

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version.
Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.

notes: ITEM payload is a native-v1 document; EXERCISE payload is the objective and exercise members of the exercise publication command (contracts/study); commandId and expectedDeckRevisionId are supplied at approval.

turns lists the turns of the current generation of the draft, oldest first, in the turn shape (REMOVE_MEDIA turns included; a retry starts a new draft, so earlier instructions are not listed); revisions lists the revisions of that generation {revisionId, cause INITIAL | EDIT | MEDIA | REPIN, createdAt}, oldest first, which are the ones a revert may restore; ?revisionId= returns any revision's payload, older generations included (an unknown one is 404) while currentRevisionId stays the pointer, so a client builds the diff of an edit from the previous and the result revision. mediaSlots are the slots of the media nodes the shown revision holds, whichever revision each slot is attached to now.

An EXERCISE detail adds the read-only display {mechanic, objectiveTitle, quotes}: the mechanic, the title of the objective the exercise evidences (the offered or the new one) and the plain text of every MATERIAL node the exercise quotes, by node id, as it reads in the pinned revision (so a client renders MATERIAL blocks without further requests). It is absent for ITEM artifacts and when revision is null. The artifact title is the first TEXT block of the prompt, else the objective title.
Model route, prompt version and provenance are never returned.
Read-only: never changes state.

endpoints.summary: Publish one artifact into the catalog in one transaction (approve).

requestHeaders.If-Match: Quoted decimal Deck rowVersion (as in contracts/items); missing 428, malformed 400, stale 412.

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version.
Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.
Deck, artifact or revision version is stale; read again, then retry with a new commandId.
If-Match missing.
State is not PROPOSED, a media slot is neither READY nor REMOVED, or a pinned source changed (the artifact became STALE in a short transaction before the publish transaction).
commandId was used for a different command.

notes: Exact retry returns the stored acknowledgement with Idempotency-Replayed: true and no ETag.
Item approval publishes through the caller-owned port into ItemService; exercise approval through ExerciseService with objective.operation=reuse where the target objective is unchanged.

The catalog command carries a command id derived from commandId and artifactId (a name-based hash shaped as a version-4 UUID, because a version-5 value is not a legal command id), so a repeat is the same command. A session CLOSED, EXPIRED, PLANNING or PLAN_READY answers ILLEGAL_STATE; a rowVersion or revision mismatch is 412 before any state conflict.

A PROPOSED EXERCISE artifact whose target material has a newer head is re-pinned by the server before the publish transaction (no model call): if every block the model was shown is unchanged in the head, every MATERIAL node of the exercise still reads as text in the new revision and the exercise passes the checks that read the material text, the publication command and the probes again, a REPIN revision replaces the current one, repinStatus is AUTO_REPINNED and the approval goes on with it; otherwise the artifact becomes STALE (NEEDS_USER_DECISION) in a short transaction of its own and the answer is 409 SOURCE_STALE.

Exercise approval publishes through the caller-owned port GeneratedExercisePublisher into ExerciseService with a child command id derived from commandId and artifactId and marks the exercise «Новое» (contracts/study). A create objective whose normalized title equals the title of an objective already bound to the same subject material is published as a reuse of it, so approving three exercises of one direction creates one objective. A reuse objective whose head moved is published against the current head while it is still bound to the subject member; a gone or foreign-bound objective makes the artifact STALE (NEEDS_USER_DECISION, 409 SOURCE_STALE).

requestBodyOptional.replacement: EXERCISE artifacts only: {objective, exercise}, the exercise the owner edited in the exercise editor before saving (the shape of getArtifact payload.command). It is read by ExerciseCommand.readCreate only (a human edit is not linted), must keep the proposal's exercise.subject.memberKey and is published INSTEAD of the revision payload; provenance records edited: true. Not valid on an ITEM artifact or inside a bulk entry (INVALID_REQUEST). It is never auto re-pinned: it is published when it already stands on the head of its material (subject and quotes carry the head revision), otherwise the proposal becomes STALE (409 SOURCE_STALE, never 412).

notes: All or nothing, in ONE database transaction: the catalog is called in-process through the caller-owned port. Items only (AI-05): ONE bulk publication, one deck revision, with a command id derived from commandId and the sorted artifact ids; with exercises (AI-13) the materials go first as one bulk publication, then ExerciseService is called once per exercise with a child command id derived from commandId and the artifact id, each on the deck revision and version the previous publication left (chained). The list is capped at 20 (the MATERIALS session maximum); the client splits a larger selection (an exercise session can hold 60) into several commands, each atomic.

The client lists exactly the artifacts it showed as approvable ('Approve all ready (N)'); an artifact that stopped being approvable fails the whole command.

endpoints.summary: Edit by selection, instruction or media redo. One edit per artifact at a time. A rewrite is accepted (202, turn QUEUED) and runs on the worker; REMOVE_MEDIA is applied before the answer.

fields.expectedRevisionId: the artifact's current revision as the client shows it (stale is 412 VERSION_CONFLICT)
fields.target: {nodeIds: 1..50 distinct node IDs of CONSECUTIVE top-level blocks of the current revision}; required for a material (absent or null is INVALID_REQUEST); null only for an EXERCISE, whose every edit is refused until AI-16
fields.action: REWRITE | IMAGE_SEARCH | IMAGE_GENERATE | AUDIO_REGENERATE | FREE | REMOVE_MEDIA
fields.preset: optional SIMPLER | SHORTER | EXAMPLE | LONGER; valid only with REWRITE (else INVALID_REQUEST); null is the same as absent
fields.instruction: text or speech transcript, 1..2000 code points, not blank; required for FREE, optional otherwise (ignored and stored as null for REMOVE_MEDIA); null is the same as absent

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version; a preset without REWRITE; FREE without an instruction; a media action on blocks of the wrong kind; or a target the edit cannot use, named by the additive `reason` member: TARGET_NOT_CONTIGUOUS (a nested node, an unknown or repeated ID, a gap), TARGET_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK (a block MBM cannot express), TARGET_PERSONAL_DATA (a block whose text holds an e-mail address, a telephone or a card number) or TARGET_MEDIA_ONLY (a rewrite of media blocks only).
errors.reason: TARGET_NOT_CONTIGUOUS | TARGET_UNSUPPORTED_BLOCK | TARGET_PERSONAL_DATA | TARGET_MEDIA_ONLY (absent for the other 400s)

errors.when: Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.
Another turn on this artifact is QUEUED or RUNNING.
The reservation or debit does not fit a credit, cap, fair-use or daily-burst limit.

A capability the operation needs is off: aiGeneration for REWRITE and FREE; imageSearch, imageGeneration or textToSpeech for the media actions, which stay refused (reason PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED when the gate itself passes) until their executors exist (AI-09, AI-10).
expectedRevisionId is not the current revision.

Operation not allowed in the current session or artifact state (states.json allowedOperations): the session is not RUNNING or REVIEW (a CANCELLED one accepts REMOVE_MEDIA only), the artifact is not PROPOSED, or the artifact is an EXERCISE (every edit, until AI-16 #294).
commandId was used for a different command.
50 turns or 30 revisions already exist on the artifact (REMOVE_MEDIA is not counted as a turn and may use the revisions up to 40), or the blocks to rewrite are too big for the output bound.

notes: A block is the unit: a selection inside a paragraph widens to its block. nodeIds must be CONSECUTIVE top-level blocks of the current revision, in any request order, and include every block the selection touches, media blocks inside the run too (a skipped media block is a gap); anything else is INVALID_REQUEST with reason TARGET_NOT_CONTIGUOUS.

Evaluation order: 404, receipt replay, 400 body, 412 expectedRevisionId, 400 target (it can only be judged against the current revision), 409 state (session, artifact, EDIT_IN_PROGRESS, EXERCISE), 409 capability, 422 limits, 409 usage last. Nothing changes state before the usage step passes.

REWRITE and FREE (as EDIT_SELECTION, 4 credits on rc-v1) create their own turn-scoped reservation (scope TURN) at admission; insufficient means 409 USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED before any state change. The hold is debited when the turn is APPLIED and released unspent when it FAILS or is CANCELLED. «Ещё раз» is a new edit with a new commandId and takes its own hold. IMAGE_SEARCH, IMAGE_GENERATE and AUDIO_REGENERATE (priced as in usage.json) are refused with 409 CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE until AI-09 and AI-10 (decision 15).

A rewrite is 202 with the turn QUEUED and the artifact REVISING; the worker runs one EDIT step (PT2M, at most three model calls: the answer, one repair, one on the strong route). The result is a new revision (cause EDIT), the turn APPLIED with resultRevisionId and the artifact PROPOSED on it; on failure the turn is FAILED with an errorCode, the artifact PROPOSED on the unchanged revision and nothing is debited. The client follows ARTIFACT_STATE and re-reads getArtifact (turns[], revisions[]).

REMOVE_MEDIA (extension to the architecture list) is free and deterministic: no model call, no reservation. It answers 202 like every edit, with the turn already APPLIED (example turnRemoveMedia), cause MEDIA, creates a revision without the media nodes (their slots become REMOVED and the hold on their assets ends) and does not count toward the 50 turns. It is the only action accepted in a CANCELLED session.

A rewrite never shows media to the model and never drops it: each media block of the target run stays in the document (same node, same slot, now attached to the new revision) right after the rewritten block that carries the node ID of the nearest text block before it in the run, in its original order; a media block that opened the run stays first, and one whose anchor did not survive the rewrite (gone or changed type) goes to the end of the range.
EXERCISE artifacts: every edit answers 409 GENERATION_STATE_CONFLICT with reason ILLEGAL_STATE until AI-16 (#294) defines the exercise edit flow.

Every block outside the target is the same JSON in the new revision (same node IDs); a rewritten block whose type is unchanged keeps its node ID (MBM handle rule), its descendants and new blocks get new IDs.

The blocks to rewrite may weigh at most 2050 estimated tokens (the output bound of 4500 holds them again and a longer rewrite): a bigger target is 422 RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with limit EDIT_TARGET_SIZE and limits.maxEditTargetTokens; the client splits the selection.

The edit is interactive: its step is offered to workers before drafts, is never parked by the daily burst, and fails its turn with DEADLINE_EXCEEDED (hold released) when no worker claimed it within learning.generation.edit.queue-timeout (PT2M).

endpoints.summary: Move the current-revision pointer to another revision of the same artifact (undo and redo of edits). Creates and deletes nothing.

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version.
Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact, or a revision that is not one of this artifact's: one opaque boundary.
Artifact changed.

Operation not allowed in the current session or artifact state: the session is not RUNNING or REVIEW, the artifact is not PROPOSED (a turn in flight makes it REVISING, which refuses a revert), it is an EXERCISE (until AI-16 #294), or the revision is from before the artifact was last retried.
commandId was used for a different command.

notes: toRevisionId must be one of the revisions listed by getArtifact (the current generation of the draft, at most 30 for rewrites): earlier or later than the current one; the current revision is a 200 no-op. A revision from before the artifact was last retried (a retry writes a new INITIAL revision from other pins) is history, readable with ?revisionId= but never restored: 409 ILLEGAL_STATE. No revision is created and none is deleted, so the history (revisions, turns) stays and a revert can be undone by another revert; an edit made after a revert is a new revision (a branch).
Evaluation order: 404, receipt replay, 400 body, 412 expectedArtifactVersion, 409 state, 404 unknown revision.

Media slots follow the shown revision: a slot whose node the revision holds is attached to it, one whose node it does not hold becomes REMOVED. Restoring a revision whose media node had its slot REMOVED shows the node without a ready asset (the hold ended): the slot is FAILED with errorCode NO_RESULT (a MEDIA_SLOT_STATE event), so approval answers 409 MEDIA_NOT_READY until REMOVE_MEDIA removes the node again.
Events: ARTIFACT_STATE (PROPOSED, new artifactVersion and currentRevisionId) and MEDIA_SLOT_STATE for each slot that changed state.

endpoints.summary: Retry a FAILED artifact (not for errorCode REFUSAL) or regenerate a STALE one against the new source revision: back to QUEUED, a new reservation is made.

errors.when: Malformed or unknown field, duplicate JSON key, bad UUID or version.
Foreign or absent deck, session or artifact: one opaque boundary.
Artifact changed.
State is not FAILED or STALE, the session does not allow it, or the errorCode is REFUSAL.
The reservation or debit does not fit a credit, cap, fair-use or daily-burst limit.
A capability the operation needs is off.
A pinned owned note or material exists but no longer matches the pin, or has been deleted since.
commandId was used for a different command.
Retrying turns a REVIEW session that does not count as active into a counted one and the account already has the maximum of active sessions.

notes: Cancels any QUEUED or RUNNING turn of the artifact.

A new STEP reservation of the artifact's weight is made first (409 USAGE_LIMIT_REACHED leaves nothing changed); the debit of the new run draws from it and it ends with the session's return to REVIEW. A STALE artifact is regenerated against the pins as they are now (the artifact's sourceRefs are replaced); a FAILED one needs its pins to hold (SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE otherwise). The slots and holds of the replaced revision are dropped.

A REVIEW session that holds only FAILED or REJECTED leftovers does not count as active; retrying makes it count again, so the 3-active-sessions limit is checked first (422 RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, limit ACTIVE_SESSIONS, before usage).
An EXERCISE artifact is written again as ONE exercise (one TEXT_DRAFT step with count 1, a STEP reservation of one exercise's credits); a STALE one is regenerated against the pins as they are now.

generationSpec.description: Immutable after create. The server clamps values and echoes the stored spec back so the client can show it as chips. Unknown fields are INVALID_REQUEST. Provisional parts are marked; the owning task finalizes them without changing the rest.

common.outputLanguage: BCP 47 per the native-v1 lexical profile; default is the deck language, else the UI language

MATERIALS.prompt: 0..2000 characters; required when there is no SOURCE source. Limit chosen equal to the turn instruction limit (architecture section 3); revisit in AI-04.
MATERIALS.sources: 0..20 pinned sources: {role: SOURCE|STYLE_EXAMPLE, type: NOTE, noteId, noteRowVersion[, overrides]} or {role, type: ITEM, memberKey, itemRevisionId}. At most 2 STYLE_EXAMPLE, items only. The pins are immutable for the session. A noteId, or a memberKey with the same itemRevisionId, may appear once: a repeat is 400 INVALID_REQUEST (artifacts and overrides are positional). A NOTE + SOURCE entry may carry sparse per-note `overrides` (decision 13): {effort?, media?: {audio?: {enabled, lang?, voice?}, imageSearch?}}; every member optional, the object and its media member non-empty (`{}` is INVALID_REQUEST, send none); an absent member keeps the session value; an `audio` override replaces the whole clip setting. Allowed only with notesMode ONE_PER_NOTE (and at least one NOTE source); on any other entry, with MERGE_INTO_ONE, or malformed: 400 INVALID_REQUEST. Echoed unchanged in the stored spec. The estimate and the admission hold price each material with its effective settings, capability checks (audio -> textToSpeech, imageSearch) apply to the effective values, and the TEXT_DRAFT context of the note's material carries the effective effort and media directives of that note only.

settings.notesMode: ONE_PER_NOTE (default) | MERGE_INTO_ONE; ignored without NOTE sources
settings.media: {audio: {enabled, lang, voice: female|male|null}, imageSearch: boolean}; per-note overrides: see sources
settings.factCheck: boolean: web research by effort (architecture section 14)
settings.similarToDeck: boolean: add deck exemplars to the brief ('Похоже на: как в колоде')
settings.planFirst: boolean: PLANNING first (needs the planner, AI-14 #295)
settings.budgetPercent: null or 1..100: spend at most this share of the current remaining budget on the session

MATERIALS.artifacts: ONE_PER_NOTE creates one artifact per NOTE source; MERGE_INTO_ONE or prompt-only creates one. More than 20 is RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
MATERIALS.media: Declared media counts bound the compiler (MBM maxMedia, at most 8 per artifact) and the estimate prices only those.

EXERCISES.targets: 1..20 materials {memberKey, itemRevisionId}: multi-select or one material profile. A deck-wide selection beyond 20 materials is split by the client into several sessions (uncovered materials first). Limit: owner decision 2026-10-02, key learning.generation.max-exercise-targets.

settings.mechanics: AUTO or a nonempty set of SELF_CHECK, FREE_RESPONSE, CLOZE, CHOICE, MATCH, ORDER, CATEGORIZE (server registry)
settings.priority: UNCOVERED_FIRST (default): the targets with the fewest enabled exercises are processed first | BALANCED: the order of the request. With BUDGET_PERCENT the resolved total is spread over the targets in that order, so a short budget serves the first ones.
settings.quantity: {mode: AUTO} | {mode: EXACT, perTarget: 1..10} | {mode: BUDGET_PERCENT, percent: 1..100}; mutually exclusive by mode. The resolved total is at most 60 exercises per session (owner decision 2026-10-02). There is NO silent clamp: above the limits the answer is 422 RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with limit and the limits, and the client offers to split into several sessions.
settings.planFirst: boolean; true is 422 SPEC_NOT_SUPPORTED (kind EXERCISES) until the planner exists (AI-14)
settings.budgetPercent: null or 1..100 (same meaning as for MATERIALS)

sessionDetail.approvableCount: Number of artifacts that can be approved now: PROPOSED with every media slot READY or REMOVED (not STALE, not REVISING). The pager summary ('7 ready') and the GENERATION_READY notification use it; the client derives 'writing' from QUEUED + GENERATING and 'failed' from FAILED.
sessionDetail.usage: {reservedCredits, spentCredits}: the session's initial-batch reservation (ACTIVE holds only), see contracts/usage
sessionDetail.notes: {used, archivable}: used = distinct NOTE sources (role SOURCE) referenced by at least one PUBLISHED or HANDED_OFF artifact and by no artifact still in play (QUEUED, GENERATING, PROPOSED, REVISING, STALE, retryable FAILED); archivable = used notes that are not archived and whose row_version still equals the pinned one. The UI shows 'Archive the used notes (k)' when k > 0 (operation archiveUsedNotes). Detail only, not in summaries.

artifactSummary.title: Preview title of the current revision (first heading or paragraph, at most 240 code points) for the pager
artifactSummary.mediaSlotCounts: {total, ready, failed} counts of slots of the current revision; the slots themselves are in getArtifact mediaSlots
artifactSummary.repinStatus: null | AUTO_REPINNED | NEEDS_USER_DECISION. NEEDS_USER_DECISION comes with STALE. AUTO_REPINNED (exercises only) comes with PROPOSED: the server moved the pins of a proposed exercise to the current head of its material without a model (a REPIN revision); it is cleared when the artifact is published or retried.
artifactSummary.publishedRef: null until PUBLISHED: {kind: ITEM, memberKey, itemRevisionId, ordinal} or {kind: EXERCISE, exerciseId, exerciseRevisionId, objectiveId, objectiveRevisionId}
artifactSummary.errorCode: null or an artifact error code (states.json artifact.errorCodes)

turn.status: QUEUED | RUNNING | APPLIED | FAILED | CANCELLED (states.json turn.states)
turn.action: REWRITE | IMAGE_SEARCH | IMAGE_GENERATE | AUDIO_REGENERATE | FREE | REMOVE_MEDIA
turn.preset: null, or SIMPLER | SHORTER | EXAMPLE | LONGER (REWRITE only)
turn.instruction: echoed text; a speech transcript is stored as text, the audio is never kept; null for REMOVE_MEDIA
turn.targetNodeIds: the block node IDs the edit addressed, in document order
turn.resultRevisionId: null until APPLIED: the revision the turn made
turn.errorCode: null, or an artifact error code when FAILED (INVALID_OUTPUT, REFUSAL, SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE, PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE, ESTIMATE_EXCEEDED, DEADLINE_EXCEEDED)
